notes: Install every app on one phone – Each NAC app now installs as its own app. Before, once one app was installed, the others opened inside it and could not be installed.
Search fits each app – In Programme Studio, Service Projector and Choir Rehearsal, Search only shows things that app has.
Practice audio button – In Programme Studio the button on a hymn now opens Practice; in Service Projector it is no longer shown.
Updates keep the hymn books – Updating online no longer downloads the hymn books and scores again.
